description.zh: 16 个田园简笔画图标：透明底上用随页面变色的描边勾勒草帽、洒水壶、风车、麦穗等乡野元素，点缀橄榄绿、麦金与陶土色。每个图标自带 pastoral- 前缀的轻柔 CSS 动画（漂浮 / 摇摆 / 旋转 / 呼吸 / 弹跳），并尊重减少动态效果设置。80×80 画布，单文件自包含，可直接内联。
description.en: 16 flat line-drawn countryside icons: strokes that follow the page color (currentColor), with olive green, wheat gold and terracotta accents — straw hat, watering can, windmill, wheat and more. Each icon ships a gentle pastoral- prefixed CSS animation (float / sway / spin / pulse / pop) and honors prefers-reduced-motion. 80×80 viewBox, self-contained single files ready to inline.

description.zh: 宽檐编织草帽，陶土色帽带上别着一朵小雏菊，轻轻漂浮。用于夏日、田园生活与户外主题。
description.en: Wide-brimmed woven straw hat with a terracotta band and a tiny daisy, gently floating. For summer, farm life and outdoor themes.

description.zh: 叶绿色洒水壶，拱形提手配长壶嘴，水滴从喷头落下。用于园艺、照料与成长。
description.en: Leaf-green watering can with an arched handle and a long spout, drops falling from the rose. For gardening, care and growth.

description.zh: 饱满的橙色胡萝卜带横纹与三簇绿叶，在微风中摇摆。用于蔬菜、收获与健康饮食。
description.en: Plump orange carrot with ridge lines and three leafy green tops, swaying in the breeze. For vegetables, harvest and healthy food.

description.zh: 金黄向日葵配褐色花盘，长在带叶的高茎上左右点头。用于夏天、阳光与快乐。
description.en: Golden sunflower with a seeded brown center on a tall leafy stem, nodding side to side. For summer, sunshine and happiness.

description.zh: 白色雏菊配阳光般的黄色花心，花瓣像风车一样缓缓转动。用于春天、清新与小确幸。
description.en: White daisy with a sunny yellow heart, its petals slowly turning like a pinwheel. For spring, freshness and simple joys.

description.zh: 陶土色圆蘑菇伞盖缀着奶油色斑点，粗短菌柄立在草丛中欢快冒出。用于林地、采集与童趣。
description.en: Round terracotta mushroom cap with cream spots on a stout stem among grass, popping up cheerfully. For forest floors, foraging and whimsy.

description.zh: 老式木质风车塔，四片格栅风帆随风稳稳转动。用于能源、乡村与四季流转。
description.en: Old timber windmill tower with four lattice sails turning steadily in the wind. For energy, countryside and the turning of seasons.

description.zh: 编织柳条篮装满奶油色新鲜鸡蛋，上方是拱形提手。用于早餐、新鲜农产与农夫市集。
description.en: Woven wicker basket brimming with fresh cream eggs under an arched handle. For breakfast, fresh produce and farm markets.

description.zh: 三株金色麦穗，颗粒饱满、麦芒细长，一起随风摇曳。用于谷物、面包、丰收与秋天。
description.en: Three golden wheat stalks with plump grains and fine awns, swaying together. For grain, bread, harvest and autumn.

description.zh: 经典奶场牛奶罐，圆顶盖、两侧提手与蓝色腰带，顶上一滴牛奶。用于乳制品、早餐与新鲜农产。
description.en: Classic dairy milk churn with a domed lid, side handles and a blue band, a drop of milk on top. For dairy, breakfast and fresh farm goods.

description.zh: 木柄干草叉，三根弯曲铁齿，倚在一小堆干草旁。用于农活、晒草与农场劳作。
description.en: Wooden pitchfork with three curved iron tines resting by a tuft of hay. For chores, hay making and farm work.

description.zh: 陶土红色谷仓，复折式屋顶、交叉白色大门与草料阁楼窗，轻柔呼吸。用于农场、仓储与大本营。
description.en: Terracotta red barn with a gambrel roof, crossed white doors and a hayloft window, breathing softly. For farms, storage and home base.

description.zh: 乡村木质田间门，两根门柱之间有斜撑，脚下草丛随风摇摆。用于入口、边界与欢迎。
description.en: Rustic wooden field gate with a diagonal brace between two posts, grass tufts swaying at its feet. For entrances, boundaries and welcome.

description.zh: 戴草帽的友好稻草人，缝线麻布脸与带补丁的衬衫挂在木十字架上，轻轻摇摆。用于田野、丰收与秋日趣味。
description.en: Friendly scarecrow with a straw hat, stitched burlap face and patched shirt on a wooden cross, swaying. For fields, harvest and autumn fun.

description.zh: 温馨的奶油色小屋，陶土色屋顶、圆顶木门，烟囱冒出缕缕轻烟。用于家园、舒适与乡村生活。
description.en: Cozy cream cottage with a terracotta roof, a round-top door and a chimney puffing soft smoke. For home, comfort and village life.

description.zh: 黄褐色仓鸮，浅色心形脸盘，栖在枝头，黑眼睛柔和闪动。用于夜晚、智慧与静静守望。
description.en: Tawny barn owl with a pale heart-shaped face perched on a branch, its dark eyes softly pulsing. For night, wisdom and quiet watch.
